self_reported.text: The learner rejected a transcript-only framing and requested a direct check of how the interaction affects the GPT app and their own learning experience.
The learner subsequently withdrew the transcript request and said they had a better solution.

observed.text: The rendered exchange shifts from requesting a downloadable transcript to requesting direct inspection of the GPT app and learning experience.
The rendered shared page shows an interrupted assistant status, followed by the learner's better-solution turn and a short assistant acknowledgment.

derived.text: A direct human-in-the-loop check should measure app behavior, learner action, and learning outcome separately; transcript interpretation alone cannot establish app impact.
Study OS should distinguish a source-transcript request from a direct app-interaction experiment and preserve the relation between them without treating one as evidence of the other.
When a learner revises the requested operation, the superseded intent and the replacement intent should remain separately attributable.

instrumentation_proposals.purpose: Identify whether the learner is interacting with ChatGPT, Study OS, a lesson task, or another surface.
Record the learner's observable action separately from model text or interpretation.
Record behavioral evidence about the learner experience without collapsing it into self-report or model judgment.
Link a superseded request to the learner's replacement request while preserving both histories.

not_claimed: This capture does not establish how the GPT app affected the learner or whether learning improved.
The rendered shared page is reconstructed evidence, not an original ChatGPT export.
The public Study OS repository contains no full transcript or raw rendered-page capture.
No learner request, tutor interpretation, or proposed instrumentation field is promoted to authoritative product or learning truth.
